title: Player of the Month System
body:
Howdy all Midnight Merc Community Gamers,

As some of you might have read the title, of course. We'll be setting up a new "Player of the Month" System. The last day of the month, the main Administrators will meet up and discuss who's been the most Loyal, Active and outgoing player within the Midnight Mercs Community. Now, you may be thinking to yourself, How might I get to be the Player of the Month and or What will I get when I am? That's a good question, You recieve "Player of the Month" for doing the following, frequently and in a good manner.

- Recruiting as much as possible

- Make an attempt to populate our servers every once and awhile

- Stay active on the forums

- Attend events frequently

- Be a good sport, and help out noobies as much as possible

- Upload screenshots in our gallery

- Upload some youtube videos of some Clan mates and you

All of the listed things are very simple, yet effective. Put some effort in to doing all of the following, and I can assure you one day you'll recieve player of the month. Prizes will be thought of via the Staff team as soon as possible.

Sincerely,
Crawford
author: Crawford

title: New events & Another chapter to unfold for the clan
body:
Hello everyone,

How're all of you? I know you may be thinking the clan is dying and we're losing member etc.. Half of that is true, we are losing members. Is that my decision, no. We're losing members due to lack of events and lack of activity, the question is, can we fix that? Yes we can, so guys post in the comments what events in what games should we have. We've got a Team Fortress 2 Server up and I'm also thinking of getting of a couple more up for free from a friend. Anyways, write in the comments what you guys think we should do and for all of you freaking out thinking the clan is dying, it's not don't worry. It could be down to just me and Magik and I wouldn't disband the clan, so don't worry about that.

Sincerely,
Crawford

title: Website Revival, New Ranking System & Recruitment
body:
Hello everyone,

It's been a while since I've posted a news post or anything on the website for that matter. Before we get into this I'd like to apologize for my shitty format and writing in general. I don't have any experience as a writer or any of that jazz. I'm just doing this solely to inform you guys what we're planning and what we're working on. Now that we've got that out of the way lets get down to the announcements. So first and foremost as you guys already know we've brought back the site and we're looking to come back in full force. With that being said, I'd like you guys to share as much as possible with the rest of the community what you did today in your game or anything that you'd think others would find interesting.

New Ranking System

We've created some fictional ranks for new members to progress through using a point system, which is still being worked on. We'll need your creative minds to help us think of how the points should be distributed, earned and a way for bonus "points" to be earned. We will be having a community meeting discussing more on this matter at the date posted below. I highly suggest you attend if you'd like your input to be considered.

Community Discussion: Saturday @ 3:00PM Central / 4:00PM Eastern 3/21/15

Recruitment

Now that our site is back and I've regained the motivation to push the community forward. We need to start bringing in some new faces. You guys don't necessarily have to go out of your way to recruit new members but I would like you guys to at least try to recruit new or current friends if possible. The more the merrier, nobody likes playing alone. At least I know I don't so lets give those lonely gamers a home. If this is not your approach to recruiting then speak to an admin and we'll give you more ideas on how to recruit.
author: RiveR

title: New teamspeak server
body: We've migrated into a new teamspeak server due to our old server constantly crashing, lagging out during events etc. We've reason to believe someone targeted us and "ddosed" the teamspeak server. Our provider informed us that the attack was directed towards 9989, our old teamspeak server port. If you need the new teamspeak info, message a member via steam or post in the shoutbox. We will no longer be giving out the teamspeak publicly on our site, forums or any where on the web for that matter. Sorry for the Inconvenience, I hope all of you have an awesome day and I'll see you dudes at the next event!
author: RiveR
